id.description: A unique identifier for the feature.

type.description: Defines the scheduling of the operating mode.

phoneNumber.description: The primary phone number configured for the feature.

extension.description: The extension configured for the feature.

modeBasedForwardingEnabled.description: A flag to indicate whether mode-based call forwarding is enabled for the feature.

forwardDestination.description: The destination for call forwarding if mode-based call forwarding is enabled.

currentOperatingModeName.description: Name of the current operating mode.

currentOperatingModeId.description: Unique identifier for the current operating mode.

exceptionType.description: Defines the exception through which the current operating mode is set as active for the feature.

location.description: Location object that has a unique identifier for the location and its name.
